newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers edge a shade higher in dull talk.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers edge a shade higher in dull talk.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were were steady to firm on crude gains but demand was dull as traders wind down at the week's end, traders said on Friday.
The market is quiet as most traders were too stressed out by the price volatility seen this week and as the pre-lunar New Year lull sets in, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98-$100 a tonne and 180-cst at $106-$107.
MDO and gas oil prices were quoted unchanged at $198-$200 and $205-$210 respectively.
